content.title: Where to watch F1 Japanese Grand Prix race tonight on Apple TV+: Time, free stream
content.text: Updated: Mar. 28, 2026, 9:30 p.m.Published: Mar. 28, 2026, 9:30 p.m.Ferrari driver Charles Leclerc of Monaco, right, steers his car ahead of Mercedes driver George Russell of Britain during the Chinese Formula One Grand Prix race at the Shanghai International Circuit, in Shanghai, China, Sunday, March 15, 2026. (AP Photo/Vincent Thian)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comFormula One racing is off to Suzuka International Racing Course on Sunday for the Japanese Grand Prix and the third race of the 2026 season. The race is scheduled to start at 1 a.m. ET (2 p.m. Sunday in Tokyo) with exclusive streaming on Apple TV+ (free trial).How to watch F1 racing on Apple TV+: Live streams of the Japanese Grand Prix are available on Apple TV+ (free trial).Apple TV is the exclusive home of F1 Racing in 2026 with rights to all 24 races on the schedule. Japanese Grand Prix 2026Formula 1 race at a glanceWhen: Saturday, March 28 at 1 a.m. ET (2 p.m. Sunday in Japan)Where: Suzuka International Racing Course, Suzuka, JapanTV channel: N/ALive streams: Apple TV+ (free trial)The Mercedes Team is off to a fast start in 2026 on the heels of a dominant run to the title by McLaren a season ago. George Russell and Kimi Antonelli took home first and second at the Australian Grand Prix (March 7), then flipped positions in Shanghai (March 15) to hold the top two spots in the driver standings. Formula 1 racing on Apple TV+: Watch with a free trialAntonelli and Russell are now positioned in the Nos 1 and 2 spots, respectively, on the starting grid in Japan.
